programme.title: Eddington
programme.desc: A standoff between a small-town sheriff and mayor sparks a powder keg as neighbor is pitted against neighbor in May 2020 in Eddington, N.M.

programme.title: Fackham Hall
programme.desc: Eric Noone begins a forbidden romance with Rose Davenport, the lady of the house at a posh English manor. When an unexpected murder occurs, Eric gets framed, leaving Rose and her family's future uncertain.

programme.title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)
programme.desc: A washed-up actor (Michael Keaton), whose previous claim to fame was his portrayal of a popular superhero, attempts to recapture his past glory by mounting a Broadway play.

programme.title: The First Purge
programme.desc: Violence and mayhem spread across the nation when the New Founding Fathers of America try a radical sociological experiment that allows citizens to vent their aggression for one night in an isolated community.

programme.title: A Revolution on Canvas
programme.desc: Sara Nodjoumi investigates the disappearance of more than 100

programme.title: Marc by Sofia
programme.desc: Sofia Coppola captures the genius and singular universe of iconic American fashion designer Marc Jacobs.

programme.title: Red Sparrow
programme.desc: Dominika Egorova learns to use her mind and body as a weapon after joining a secret intelligence service. As she comes to terms with her new abilities, Dominika meets a CIA agent who tries to convince her that he is the only person she can trust.

programme.title: Just Friends
programme.desc: A music executive (Ryan Reynolds) tries to woo his high-school crush (Amy Smart) while keeping his suspicious ex-girlfriend (Anna Faris) at bay.

programme.title: Little Fockers
programme.desc: As two clans descend on the scene of young twins' birthday, Greg Focker's moonlighting at a pharmaceutical company threatens to derail his position of trust with Jack, his uptight father-in-law.

programme.title: Tag
programme.desc: Music teacher Tag meets Farida, and a whirlwind love story develops. Tag starts to display superhuman powers of mysterious origins. He tries to hide them, but keeps facing situations that force him to intervene, especially when his brother shows up.

programme.title: The Royal Tenenbaums
programme.desc: An errant father (Gene Hackman) tries to reconcile with his eccentric and underachieving family (Anjelica Huston, Ben Stiller) in New York.

programme.title: Love, Simon
programme.desc: Teenager Simon Spier hasn't told his family or friends that he's gay, and he doesn't know the identity of the anonymous classmate that he's fallen for online. Resolving both issues proves hilarious, terrifying and life-changing.

programme.title: Materialists
programme.desc: A young, ambitious New York City matchmaker finds herself torn between the perfect match and her imperfect ex.

programme.title: The Invite
programme.desc: Joe and Angela's marriage is on thin ice. When their upstairs neighbors visit for a dinner party, the night spirals into unexpected places. Have they reignited the spark or lit the match that burns it all down?

programme.title: Anyone But You
programme.desc: Despite an amazing first date, Bea and Ben's initial attraction quickly turns sour. However, when they unexpectedly find themselves at a destination wedding in Australia, they pretend to be the perfect couple to keep up appearances.

programme.title: House Party
programme.desc: Aspiring club promoters and best buds Damon and Kevin need a huge windfall to make their problems go away. They decide to host the party of the year at an exclusive mansion, which just happens to belong to none other than NBA superstar LeBron James.

programme.title: Life of the Party
programme.desc: Dumped by her husband, longtime housewife Deanna turns regret into reset by going back to college. Winding up at the same school as her daughter, Deanna plunges headlong into the campus experience -- embracing the fun, the freedom and the frat boys.

programme.title: Boys Go to Jupiter
programme.desc: Billy 5000, a teenage gig worker with a rise-and-grind mindset, aims to make $5,000. His quest is derailed by a gelatinous alien's appearance.

programme.title: David Bowie: The Last Five Years
programme.desc: A detailed look at the final five years of David Bowie's life when he not only began producing music again, but returned to the core and defining themes of his career.

programme.title: Paul Anka: His Way
programme.desc: An all-encompassing tribute, brimming with archival footage and candid moments, Anka, still going strong, offers in his own words a vivid glimpse into his remarkable life and enduring legacy.

programme.title: Happy Feet Two
programme.desc: Reluctant to dance, the son of Mumble (Elijah Wood) the tap-dancing penguin runs away from home and meets a penguin that can fly.

programme.title: The Man Who Invented Christmas
programme.desc: Using real-life inspiration and his vivid imagination, author Charles Dickens brings Ebenezer Scrooge, Tiny Tim and other classic characters to life in A Christmas Carol, forever changing the holiday season into the celebration known today.

programme.title: Prancer: A Christmas Tale
programme.desc: Ten-year-old Gloria and her grandfather Bud befriend a mysterious reindeer when the family gathers for Christmas. Bud comes to believe that Prancer may actually be magical, but Gloria fears his theory will send him straight to a retirement home.

programme.title: Christmas With the Kranks
programme.desc: A Chicago couple scramble to put together a holiday celebration after their daughter decides to come home for Christmas.

programme.title: A Very Harold & Kumar 3D Christmas
programme.desc: Six years after their last adventure, the infamous stoners (John Cho, Kal Penn) reunite on Christmas Eve to find a replacement tree for the one Harold sent up in smoke.

programme.title: Taken 2
programme.desc: Taken hostage with his wife in Istanbul, retired CIA agent Bryan Mills (Liam Neeson) enlists his daughter's (Maggie Grace) aid in helping him escape, then uses his particular set of skills to exact revenge on the kidnappers.

programme.title: Greenland
programme.desc: A family embarks on a perilous journey as a planet-killing comet hurtles toward Earth. As the countdown to the global apocalypse approaches zero, their incredible trek culminates in a desperate and last-minute flight to a possible safe haven.

programme.title: Greenland 2: Migration
programme.desc: In the aftermath of a comet strike that decimated most of the planet, the Garrity family must leave the safety of their Greenland bunker to traverse a shattered world in search of a new home.
